purpose: Isolate warmup and gradient-clipping effects at exact S1 (~100K) and S2 (~1M) model scales using one incumbent AdamW/LR recipe, identical initialization, and identical batch traces.

incumbent.lr_basis: TRAIN-33 incumbent diagnostics: 3e-4 remained finite while 1e-3 produced about 2.7-3x larger relative updates; no LR retuning is authorized here.

warmup.selection_rule: Among PASS candidates within 1% of the best final validation loss, minimize early loss-spike ratio, then gradient-norm p95, then initialization-recovery tokens, then warmup steps.

clipping.threshold_basis: TRAIN-33 observed pre-clip norms were about 2.8 at S1 and 10.8-18.1 at S2; 1.0 clipped every observed step, so 3.0 and 10.0 are needed to test occasional-safety behavior.
clipping.warmup_source: selected independently per stage by the warmup selection rule
clipping.selection_rule: Prefer PASS candidates within 1% of the best final validation loss whose clip frequency is <=10%; among those choose the smallest finite threshold, otherwise prefer no clipping over clipping every step.

interpretation: Engineering stability evidence only. The controlled S0 fixture is not S1/S2 corpus evidence and cannot support quality/capability claims.
